write_orca_input_files: write ORCA input files for an ASE Atoms object with specified charge, multiplicity, and NBO settings
estimate_orca_memory: estimate the memory requirement in MB for an ORCA job given an ASE Atoms object and spin multiplicity
count_basis_functions: count the number of def2-TZVPD basis functions for an ASE Atoms object by element
generate_symmetry_break_block: generate an ORCA SCF rotate block to break symmetry for open-shell singlet calculations
review_optimization_parameters: review the LOOSE_OPT_PARAMETERS, OPT_PARAMETERS, TIGHT_OPT_PARAMETERS, and EVAL_OPT_PARAMETERS dictionaries for geometry optimization settings
